summary: A Fox News Entertainment roundup of country music couples and their advice for lasting marriages, including Tim McGraw and Faith Hill, Garth Brooks and Trisha Yearwood, Amy Grant and Vince Gill, Chris and Morgane Stapleton, Martina and John McBride, Dolly Parton and Carl Thomas Dean, Keith Urban and Nicole Kidman, and Carrie Underwood and Mike Fisher. Common themes are early commitment, communication, patience, humor, faith and putting family first.
one_line: Country stars like Tim McGraw, Garth Brooks, Dolly Parton and Carrie Underwood share their secrets to long-lasting marriages.
key_facts: Tim McGraw and Faith Hill met in 1994, began dating in 1996 and married later that year; both are 56 and have three daughters: Gracie, Maggie and Audrey.
McGraw said he and Hill committed early on that they "wouldn't just walk out the door when problems arose."

Garth Brooks and Trisha Yearwood married in 2005 and have been married 18 years; Yearwood became a bonus mom to his three daughters from his first marriage to Sandy Maul, which ended in divorce in 2000.
Yearwood said her relationship with Brooks is "always a first date."
Amy Grant and Vince Gill have been married since 2000 (23 years) and have a daughter named Corrina.

Last July Amy Grant suffered a traumatic head injury in a bike accident after hitting a pothole, was knocked unconscious for up to 15 minutes and postponed her fall tour; she credited Gill with providing a "grounding" place to heal.
Chris Stapleton, 45, said the key to marriage is communication, along with love, kindness and patience; he and Morgane married in October 2007 and have five children.
Morgane Stapleton sings background on 10 songs on Chris Stapleton's album "Higher" and is a producer on the project.
Martina McBride and John McBride have been married 35 years, have three daughters (Delaney, Emma and Ava), and opened Blackbird Studios in Nashville in 2002.
Dolly Parton has been married to Carl Thomas Dean since 1966 (56 years); she said, "I stay going," and credits humor and separate interests.
Keith Urban and Nicole Kidman have been married 17 years and met in 2005; Urban says the rule is "It's always family first"; their daughters are Sunday Rose and Faith Margaret.
Carrie Underwood and former NHL player Mike Fisher married in 2010 (13 years), have sons Isaiah and Jacob, and credit their faith for helping overcome obstacles.
